app_subtitle: Data collection and strategic analysis for family farms and producer organisations
no_diagnostics: No diagnostics yet. Create your first diagnostic.
import_help: Import an Excel or CSV file following the provided template.
import_success: Import successful. Review and complete the data below.
import_error: Import error. Please check the file format.
import_word_help: For existing Word diagnostics without a fixed template (one or several parts, e.g. general + economic and financial diagnostic). AI extracts the information into the advisory star — review and correct before saving.
import_word_upload: Choose one or more Word files (.docx)
import_word_review_hint: Diagnostic pre-filled: review and correct each branch before clicking Save.
import_word_needs_key: Word import requires a configured API key. Meanwhile, use the Excel template above, or fill in manually.
analysis_incomplete: Fill in at least Market, Local environment and Public policies to run the analysis.
plan_intro: Review, correct and complete the plan before validating it.
validation_checkbox: I validate this strategic plan and action plan
validation_required: Advisor validation is required before the plan can be downloaded.
field_required_hint: Some fields are empty — not blocking, but it reduces analysis quality.
activity_market_share: Relative market share (0-2, 1 = equal to leader)
setup_auth_intro: No account is configured yet: the app is accessible without a password. Generate here the secret to add in Streamlit Cloud to enable it.
setup_auth_instructions: Copy this block and paste it into Settings > Secrets of your Streamlit Cloud app (after the other secrets), then Save. The login screen will appear on next load.
reveal_names_warning: Real EFA/PO names are now visible in the interface.
include_real_name_export: Include the real name in the document (internal use only)
include_real_name_warning: ⚠️ This document will contain the real EFA/PO name — share internally only.
chat_placeholder: Describe the producer's situation, the agent will fill in the form...
chat_unavailable_offline: The conversational mode requires an Internet connection. Use the guided form below.
no_analysis_yet: Run the strategic analysis first in the 'Strategic analysis' tab.
field_contact_always_mask: 🔒 Always mask this contact (even if 'Show names' is on)
field_contact_always_mask_help: Extra protection: useful if the producer requested strict confidentiality of their contact details.
plan_financement_help: Resources and uses for the period, entered by category. The agent automatically computes totals, the funding balance, 10 indicators, and an indicative situation assessment.
histoire_help: Key stages and changes before, at creation, and since the creation of the business.
env_partenaires: Technical and financial partners, suppliers, local environment
parcelles_help: All plots (owned, borrowed, rented...), including those not used in year N.
schema_help: Generated from the plots and activities entered above: the land base, activities, and their inbound/outbound flows.
schema_no_data: Enter at least one plot or activity (tab 'Activity description') to generate the diagram.
calendrier_help: Calendar of all activities (production, crafts, trade, services) over the observed period.
activites_help: One sheet per activity: inbound/outbound flows, description, resources, organisation, technical-economic performance and margins.
activite_flux_entrants_help: Nature (Farmer group/Members/Suppliers), quantities, flow type (Purchase/Contribution/Internal transfer).
activite_flux_sortants_help: Nature (Farmer group/Members/Users), quantities, flow type (Sale/Donation or distribution/Internal transfer).
activite_liens: Links and interactions with other activities
activite_itineraire_help: Operation name, description, who, how/resources used, when.
activite_chronogramme_help: Quantities (area, kg, headcount, hours...) and values (expenses, revenue) per relevant month.
immo_help: Land, plantations, equipment, machinery, buildings, infrastructure.
diag_fin_help: Overall gross margin, EBE and safety margin, automatically calculated from activity margins.
diag_fin_charges_structure_help: Fixed costs not allocated to any specific activity.
diag_fin_fdr_help: Notes or values on how working capital changed from one period to the next.
bilan_desequilibre: ⚠️ The balance sheet is not balanced (gap of {ecart:,.0f})
bilan_debut_help: Financial position at the start of the observed period (year N-1).
bilan_fin_help: Financial position at the end of the observed period (year N).
bilan_financement_help: Uses and sources of funds for the period, automatically calculated from the change between the opening and closing balance sheets.
bilan_parts_sociales: Cooperative shares (co-op, PO, GIE, farmer group, bank...)
bilan_avances_membres: Member advances (what members owe the PO)
bilan_cp_efa_help: AFF formula: Opening capital + Net subsidies + Net income + Contributions - Private withdrawals
bilan_cp_op_help: PO formula: Initial share capital + Reserves/provisions + Net subsidies + Year N reserves
bilan_reserves_provisions: Reserves and provisions (accumulated from prior years)
bilan_dettes_op: Debts owed to the PO (what the AFF owes its PO)
bilan_dettes_associes: Debts owed to associates/members (what the PO owes its members)
bilan_partie1: Part 1 — Fixed uses and sources of funds
bilan_partie2: Part 2 — Working capital uses and sources
parcelle_site_help: Leave blank if the AFF/PO has a single site. Otherwise, name the site this item belongs to (e.g. 'Headquarters', 'Nkolbisson site').
siege_help: Location and description of the headquarters (office, family compound, gathering place...).
paysage_help: River, road, forest, well, etc. — and how the AFF/PO uses them.
schema_multi_site_help: Multiple sites detected: a general plan and a detailed plan per site are available.
amortissements_help: Automatically generated from the assets entered in the Business > Financial diagnosis tab. Land is not depreciable.
amortissements_no_data: No assets entered yet. Fill them in under 'Business' > 'Financial diagnosis' > 'Assets'.
amortissements_foncier_note: ℹ️ Land is not depreciable under standard accounting rules — always shown as 'Not depreciable', regardless of any value entered.
